## Holiday Downtime, Game Time: Our Picks for Playing Skillz This Season


- by Skillz
- Nov. 12, 2026
- 4 min read


-
-
-
-


The end of the year is full of in-between moments: waiting at the gate, riding in the back seat, or relaxing after the gifts are opened. Those pockets of downtime are a great time for a quick match.


In this guide, we pair some of our favorite Skillz games with the holiday moments that suit them best, plus a few tips for playing on the go this season.


## **Our Picks for Every Holiday Moment**


**Holiday moment** **Our pick** **Why it fits**


Waiting at the airport gate


Ball Sort: Real Cash


Short puzzles that fit between boarding announcements


Riding as a passenger on a road trip


Word Search Real Cash Tournaments


Relaxed word hunting that rewards steady focus


Family gatherings


Speed Pool


A game nearly everyone recognizes, which makes it easy to share


A quiet night in


Golf Blitz 3D


Rewards careful aim when you can give it your full attention


Slow mornings over the break


Sushi Drop


Colorful puzzle play to start the day


## **Waiting at the Gate**


Holiday travel means lines, delays, and plenty of time to fill. Ball Sort: Real Cash is a natural fit for the airport because its short puzzles move quickly and keep you engaged from start to finish. Just make sure you have time to finish a match before your group is called.


## **On the Road**


If someone else is driving, Word Search Real Cash Tournaments are an easy way to pass the miles. It’s a classic format most players already know, and a sharp eye pays off every round.


## **With Family**


Holiday gatherings bring together relatives of every age. Speed Pool is a great game to show a parent, grandparent, or cousin, since almost everyone has picked up a pool cue at some point. Blackout Poker is another easy one to share with the card players in the family. Start them off in practice mode so they can learn the controls with nothing on the line.


## **A Quiet Night In**


When the house finally settles down, it’s a good time for a game that rewards focus. Golf Blitz 3D asks you to line up each shot with care, which makes it a satisfying way to end a busy day.


## **Slow Mornings Over the Break**


With a few days off, mornings tend to move a little slower. Sushi Drop is a bright, upbeat way to wake up your brain over a cup of coffee or cocoa, and Dice Cash is a deeper option if you want a game that takes more careful planning.


## **Tips for Playing on the Go**


- **Check your connection first.** Skillz matches are played online, so start a match when you have a steady Wi-Fi or cellular signal, not right before your phone switches to airplane mode.


- **Pack a charger.** A portable battery keeps your phone ready for boarding passes, photos, and a match or two.


- **Bring headphones.** They help you focus and keep game sounds from distracting the people around you.


- **Warm up with a practice game.** A quick practice round helps you settle in before you compete, especially in a new setting.


- **Set your own limits.** Decide ahead of time how long you want to play so games stay a fun part of your break.


Looking for a new favorite to try over the holidays? Our guide to finding a Skillz game that fits your play style can help you choose.


## **Make the Most of Your Holiday Break**


However you spend the season, a few minutes of friendly competition can make the in-between moments a little more fun. Download a new Skillz game before you travel, and follow Skillz on social media for updates, tips, and community highlights throughout the holidays.


Happy holidays from all of us at Skillz.
